view: PA (frontal) chest radiograph, upright; L marker at image top-right confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate penetration and inspiration (about 8-9 posterior ribs visible); mild rotation not significant; scapulae partially project over the lateral upper zones bilaterally; no cropping of costophrenic angles.

devices.type: external radiographic side marker (L) and label/annotation artifact
devices.location: image top-right corner over the left shoulder region, outside the thorax

abnormalities.finding: Well-defined rounded/ovoid soft-tissue opacity approximately 2 cm projecting over the lateral right lower zone at about the level of the 7th-8th posterior rib, just inside the lateral chest wall; differential is a pulmonary nodule/mass versus a nipple shadow

Smaller rounded opacity about 1.5 cm in the lateral left lower zone (near the mid/lower zone junction), roughly symmetric with the right-sided opacity, raising the possibility of bilateral nipple shadows; a second nodule cannot be excluded
Prominent, somewhat bulky and lobulated hila bilaterally with accentuated perihilar bronchovascular markings; bilateral hilar enlargement (e.g. lymphadenopathy) cannot be excluded

description_zh: 正面站立胸部X光，吸氣與穿透度尚可，雙側肩胛骨部分重疊於上肺野外側，未見胸管、導管或其他植入裝置。右下肺野外側可見一約2公分邊緣清楚之圓形軟組織密度陰影，左下肺野外側亦見一約1.5公分較小之類似圓形陰影，兩者位置大致對稱，需考慮乳頭陰影，但無法排除肺結節；建議加照乳頭標記片或側位片確認。雙側肺門稍顯飽滿並有肺門周圍支氣管血管紋理增加，不能排除雙側肺門淋巴結腫大。心臟大小正常，縱膈未見明顯增寬，雙側肋膈角銳利，無胸水或氣胸，骨骼未見明顯病灶。
